newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Atmos Energy cut to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Atmos Energy cut to buy.

text.p: -- Stephens Inc said it downgraded Atmos Energy Corp to buy from strong buy.
-- cited announcement that Atmos President and Chief Operating Officer Bob Stephens is resigning.
-- Stephens Inc speculates Bob Stephens is resigning due to the board's decision to bring in a chief executive from outside the company.
-- Stephens Inc said it expects Atmos to announce a new chief executive within the next two weeks.
-- said there could be more departures from Atmos senior management, depending on who will assume the CEO job.
-- said disappointment over this series of events could cause downward pressure on the stock over the next several days.
-- Atmos lost 1/8 to 23-1/2 in morning trading.
